verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for a hosted search API, so the axis applies. The pack shows no open-source code or license for the Brave Search API itself. The GitHub-hosted MCP server is a separate integration component, and no license for it is stated, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
